title: values/switches.yaml
description: What an env turns on, by name only. jarvis validate also checks each add-on name against core. Hosted apps are listed in values/apps.yaml.

features.description: Core features this env turns on, by name: a folder under core/feature/. Off until listed.

addons.description: Add-ons this env turns on, by folder name under core's addons/. At most one per slot.
